name: Farkolus
backstory: One of two shopkeepers who keep stalls under the Dome Market's old roof - dry goods, mostly, whatever comes in reliable. Patches the cracked stretch of dome over his own row out of pocket when the city won't pay for it, and walks down to the docks most mornings to see what's come in before the other stallholders do.

criterion.standard: counts it a life well spent only if the market he's kept is still standing, stone for stone, when he's done with it
criterion.wasted_life: a stall kept open under a roof he let crack, propped up with borrowed tarps until someone else's dome fell in instead of his own
criterion.trusts: a repair he can point to and a contract that says who paid for it
criterion.distrusts: a promise about the roof with nothing behind it but someone's word

arc.premise: Farkolus wants the cracked section of the Dome Market's old roof actually fixed before the rains, not patched again with borrowed tarps - real stone, a real crew, before the season turns. He's heard, secondhand and unconfirmed, that there's a mason still living in Terfila who trained on the original dome-work generations back, though he hasn't found her yet.
